warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.innateDesc: A sturdy frontline fighter. Attacks have a chance to deal splash damage to all enemies.

innateSkill.name: Cleave
innateSkill.desc: Chance to deal 100% damage to all enemies.

mage.name: Mage
mage.innateDesc: Master of the arcane. Attacks have a chance to detonate, hitting all enemies.

innateSkill.name: Arcane Blast
innateSkill.desc: Chance to hit all enemies with magical force.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.innateDesc: Swift and deadly. Attacks have a chance to steal extra gold.

innateSkill.name: Pickpocket
innateSkill.desc: Chance to steal 5 Gold on hit.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.innateDesc: A holy defender. Attacks have a chance to heal the player.

innateSkill.name: Holy Strike
innateSkill.desc: Chance to heal for 20% of Max HP on hit.

beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
beastmaster.innateDesc: Wild combatant. Attacks have a chance to trigger a massive beast bite.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.innateDesc: Master of death. Attacks have a chance to drain life from the entire enemy pack.

innateSkill.name: Soul Drain
innateSkill.desc: Chance to hit all enemies for 50% damage and heal for that amount.

monk.name: Monk
monk.innateDesc: A martial artist with blazing speed. Attacks have a chance to trigger a rapid 3-hit combo.

innateSkill.name: Flurry of Blows
innateSkill.desc: Chance to strike the enemy 2 extra times instantly.

bard.name: Bard
bard.innateDesc: A supportive wanderer. Attacks have a chance to generate free Runes mid-combat.

innateSkill.name: Song of Wealth
innateSkill.desc: Chance to generate 1 Upgrade Rune during the fight.

druid.name: Druid
druid.innateDesc: Channeler of nature. Attacks have a chance to wrap other enemies in crushing vines.

innateSkill.name: Crushing Roots
innateSkill.desc: Chance to deal 50% damage to all un-targeted enemies.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.innateDesc: A lethal marksman. Has a rare chance to instantly assassinate standard monsters.

innateSkill.name: Headshot
innateSkill.desc: Chance to instantly kill a non-boss enemy.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.innateDesc: An unstoppable force of rage with terrible defense. Occasionally deals massive double damage.

innateSkill.name: Blood Frenzy
innateSkill.desc: Chance to deal 200% double damage on a hit.

warlock.name: Warlock
warlock.innateDesc: Wields dangerous forbidden magic. Deals devastating damage but sacrifices their own health to do it.

innateSkill.name: Dark Sacrifice
innateSkill.desc: Chance to deal 300% triple damage, but you lose 5% Max HP.
